These tutorials take you from zero to a working multimodal alignment,
introducing one concept at a time.  Each notebook uses real-world data
from the project's specimen collection and can be run locally after
installing the library with `pip install "timetoalign[tutorial]"`.

**Prerequisites:** Python 3.11+, basic familiarity with Jupyter notebooks.

## Tutorial Notebooks

::: {#tutorial-listing}
:::


## Topics at a Glance

The tutorials are designed to be followed in order, grouped into the
same four topics used throughout the documentation:

### Timelines, Events & Maps

- [Quickstart](tutorials/tut00_quickstart.ipynb) ---
  A five-minute tour of Timelines, Groups, Bundles, and Grids.
- [Timelines, Events, and Maps](tutorials/tut01a_timelines_events_maps.ipynb) ---
  Loading, EventStore, Coordinate, and ConversionMap.
- [Children, Regions, and Timestamps](tutorials/tut01b_children_regions_timestamps.ipynb) ---
  Hierarchy and cross-section queries.

### TimelineGroups

- [Timeline Groups and Commensurability](tutorials/tut02_timeline_groups.ipynb) ---
  TimelineGroup, coordinate transfer, and partial alignment.

### AlignmentBundles

- [Alignment Bundles](tutorials/tut03_alignment_bundles.ipynb) ---
  MatchfileLoader, AlignmentBundle, and cross-group transfer.

### In-depth Topics

- [Flow Control and Grids](tutorials/tut04_flow_and_grids.ipynb) ---
  BeatGrid, repeats, and metrical structure.

### Data & Type Model

- [DataFields and Layered EventData](tutorials/tut05_datafields_and_eventdata.ipynb) ---
  The Protocol/Scalar/Field triple, raw and semantic fields, discovery,
  and Parquet-embedded metadata.
- [Pitch and Harmony across Formats](tutorials/tut06_pitch_and_harmony.ipynb) ---
  Cross-format pitch equivalence and the typed view each format affords,
  applied to pitch and harmony.
